changeReason: A pre-score run stopped when the batched judge omitted one criterion after retries. V1.1 conservatively maps missing, duplicate-displaced, or non-binary criterion answers to unclear and incorrect. The sample, adaptive policy, models, thresholds, and uncertainty method are unchanged; all cases are rerun from scratch.
population: held-out quarterly forgetting-bearing Memora questions where the frozen MemoryCore Base top-5 contains at least one stale assertion
policyProvenance: selected automatically on weekly/monthly by lifecycle-adaptive-v1.0 before any quarterly E2E answer was generated

evaluation.judgeMode: single fixed judge; all criteria for one answer batched in one JSON response
evaluation.invalidJudgeAnswer: map missing, duplicate-displaced, or non-binary answers to unclear and incorrect
